review.summary: Real, dated trigger (EU PPWR applies since 12 Aug 2026; Etsy now asks for EPR IDs but tells sellers to work out the rules themselves), and a $29 plan is cheap against 190 EUR/country representatives. Demand for a plan (vs. having it done for them) is unproven, so it earns only a two-week waitlist test.
